text:
I can't say whether tree cover changed in 2026, because the evidence doesn't cover that year. The Hansen annual series ends in 2025, and nothing in this run was observed for 2026, even though the run date is November 2026.

The run also returned no loss or gain events for 2021-2025. It only gives baseline context:
- Tree cover in 2000 (≥30% canopy) was 48.4 ha (Hansen).
- Forest in 2020 was 43.3 ha, about 11.55% of the 374.8 ha property (JRC).

Because no change events were reported, I can't tell whether none occurred or whether the run simply didn't return them. Don't read this as "no change."

Detection is limited to events of at least 0.5 ha at 30 m resolution. The tool is also an early-access version (land-change/1).

To answer for 2026, you would need to wait for the next Hansen annual release or use another data source that covers 2026.
